description: Shadow alpha-signal substrate. Multi-provider scoring (aurora adapter, TA ensemble, judge experts), virtual trader, objective feedback. Phase 1 LLM Judge contract surface (typed verdicts, schemas, config) under judge/ sub-package. Phase 2 revived legacy experts (signal_weights, feature_neutrals) with shadow emission. Phase 3 chamber substrate (admissibility, aggregation, roster-truth accounting, shadow telemetry). Phase 4 evidence envelope + deterministic shadow verdict path.

components.name: backtest_plugin.py
components.role: AlphaSearchBacktestPlugin — FSM listener, two-phase bridge, multi-provider scoring.

components.name: alpha_model.py
components.role: AlphaModel base class, AlphaScore dataclass, AlphaModelRegistry.

components.name: judge/contracts.py
components.role: Phase 1 Pydantic contract models: ExpertOutput, ChamberAggregate, JudgeEvidenceEnvelope, JudgeVerdict.

components.name: judge/config_models.py
components.role: JudgeCortexConfig with phase-gated mode admission. Phase 2: expert configs, shadow log config. Phase 3: ChamberConfig. Phase 4: VerdictConfig + cross-config invariant.

components.name: judge/experts/signal_weights_expert.py
components.role: Phase 2 revived legacy flat weighted-centering expert (AlphaModel subclass).

components.name: judge/experts/feature_neutrals_expert.py
components.role: Phase 2 revived legacy direction-strength composite expert (AlphaModel subclass).

components.name: judge/experts/expert_output_bridge.py
components.role: Phase 2 AlphaScore→ExpertOutput bridge, JSONL shadow log writer. Phase 3: chamber JSONL log writer. Phase 4: envelope + verdict JSONL log writers.

components.name: judge/chamber/__init__.py
components.role: Phase 3 chamber sub-package. Exports ChamberAggregator, evaluate_admissibility.

components.name: judge/chamber/chamber_aggregator.py
components.role: Phase 3 ChamberAggregator: consensus direction, strength, roster-truth accounting.

components.name: judge/envelope/envelope_assembler.py
components.role: Phase 4 stateless evidence envelope assembler. Packages ChamberAggregate + context into JudgeEvidenceEnvelope.

components.name: judge/verdict/verdict_synthesizer.py
components.role: Phase 4 deterministic verdict synthesizer. Maps chamber consensus + admissibility to typed JudgeVerdict.

ssot_notes.judge_phase1_status: Contracts and schemas only. No runtime. No event emission. Mode='off' enforced.
ssot_notes.judge_phase2_status: Legacy expert revival. Shadow emission via EVT:JUDGE_EXPERT_PRODUCED_V1. Mode='shadow' admitted.
ssot_notes.judge_phase3_status: Chamber substrate. Shadow emission via EVT:JUDGE_CHAMBER_AGGREGATED_V1. Admissibility, aggregation, roster-truth. Mode='shadow'.
ssot_notes.judge_phase4_status: Evidence envelope + deterministic shadow verdict. Shadow emission via EVT:JUDGE_EVIDENCE_ASSEMBLED_V1, EVT:JUDGE_ENTRY_VERDICT_V1, EVT:JUDGE_LIFECYCLE_VERDICT_V1. Mode='shadow'.
